overview: This deck is a high-powered Jund blitz reanimator strategy helmed by Henzie "Toolbox" Torre. The primary game plan uses dense one-mana acceleration to cast Henzie on Turn 2, enabling high-mana-value creatures to enter with haste, discount, and on-death card draw on Turn 3. The deck transitions quickly into overwhelming mid-game pressure by blitzing disruptive heavy hitters like Archon of Cruelty, Massacre Wurm, and Terror of the Peaks. These creatures attack immediately, generate massive enter-the-battlefield value, and fill the graveyard upon dying at the end step. The deck converts this graveyard setup into a decisive win using mass reanimation spells like Living Death and Bringer of the Last Gift, or repeated burst damage via Moraug, Fury of Akoum. Free interaction like Deflecting Swat and Deadly Rollick safeguards the engine during critical development turns.

core_strategy: Deploy a 1-CMC mana accelerator on Turn 1 to ensure a consistent Turn 2 cast of Henzie "Toolbox" Torre.
Blitz 4-drop and 5-drop ramp or value creatures on Turn 3 to accelerate mana, apply early combat damage, and draw replacement cards upon sacrifice.
Chain high-CMC threat creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Terror of the Peaks, and Maha, Its Feathers Night to dismantle opposing boards and hand sizes.
Cast Living Death or Bringer of the Last Gift to return all sacrificed blitz threats to the battlefield simultaneously and close out the table.

mulligan_priorities.keep: Hands containing 2 to 3 lands with balanced Jund colors, at least one 1-CMC mana dork, and a castable 4-to-5 CMC blitz payoff creature.
mulligan_priorities.avoid: Hands without green mana, hands lacking 1-CMC ramp, or opening hands clogged exclusively with 6+ CMC creatures.

key_tips: Embrace sacrificing blitzed creatures; dying triggers card draw and stocks your graveyard for powerful mass reanimation spells.
Combine Maha, Its Feathers Night with Massacre Wurm or Balefire Dragon to wipe all opposing creatures regardless of their size.
Save Deflecting Swat or Heroic Intervention to protect key mass reanimation spells or Henzie during pivotal setup turns.

critical: Static graveyard hate such as Rest in Peace or Leyline of the Void stops reanimation payoffs and severely diminishes card recursion value.
Repeated early removal targeting Henzie "Toolbox" Torre stalls blitz cost reduction and delays creature deployment.
moderate: Rule of Law and spell-limiting stax pieces restrict chaining blitz spells with reanimation or interaction in the same turn.
Instant-speed countermagic targeting key sorcery-speed mass reanimation spells like Living Death.
minor: Incremental life loss from pain lands, fetchlands, and reanimation effects like Reanimate and Phyrexian Delver.

justifications.r1: Dense suite of eight 1-CMC dorks guarantees Turn 2 Henzie deployment followed by compounding land-ramp creatures.
justifications.r2: Every blitzed creature automatically replaces itself upon death, augmented by Greater Good, Skullclamp, and Vaultborn Tyrant.
justifications.a1: Birthing Ritual, Timeless Witness, and dense redundancy of interchangeable ETB/death creatures eliminate variance.
justifications.a2: The primary engine is ready and active on Turn 3, deploying discounted haste threats ahead of curve.
justifications.p1: Presents overwhelming must-answer lethal combat and ETB pressure starting on Turn 4.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent response cycles to conclude the game via repeated combat and reanimation burst.
justifications.p3: Haste dramatically compresses interaction windows; blitz creatures extract full value even if answered.
justifications.i1: Free interaction (Deflecting Swat, Deadly Rollick) alongside creature ETB removal (Druid of Purification, Necron Deathmark, Tear Asunder).
justifications.i2: Maha + Massacre Wurm, Balefire Dragon, Archon of Cruelty, and Kardur systematically dismantle opposing boards and lock out attacks.
justifications.s1: Heroic Intervention, Deflecting Swat, and Delighted Halfling protect the engine; blitz creatures bypass spot removal by dying profitably.
justifications.s2: Living Death, Bringer of the Last Gift, and Victimize turn board wipes directly into instant-win states.
justifications.s3: High-CMC threats can be hardcast independently; mass reanimation operates effectively even without Henzie on the field.
